headline: A law that renames the VA clinic in Bend, Oregon, after a man named Robert D. Maxwell.
what_it_does: This law names the Department of Veterans Affairs clinic in Bend, Oregon, the Robert D. Maxwell Department of Veterans Affairs Clinic. It may also be called the Robert D. Maxwell VA Clinic. The law changes only the clinic's name and does not change its services, staff, or rules.
when_it_takes_effect: It took effect when it was signed into law on October 13, 2020.
